text: Resolved DECISION-1 by raising the predicate schemaVersion to 0.3 and leaving the type URL fixed, which is the mechanism PAWL-011 AC5 already built and used for the 0.1 to 0.2 move. The draft framed it as a choice between moving the URL and documenting v0.1 tolerance; both ignored what was already in the tree, and one proposed changing a URL PAWL-011 exists to keep still. There was no decision to take

verified_by.ref: PredicateSchemaVersion is 0.2 in internal/model, raised by PAWL-011 AC5
